editorial:
Imagine being a young girl who just lost her parents and feeling totally alone in the world. That is where you start with this story. You meet a lonely kid who finds a strange new friend in a man who escaped from a mental hospital. It starts off feeling like an odd friendship, but you quickly realize that this man is actually very dangerous. The vibe is creepy and tense because you know something bad is going to happen, but you keep watching to see how long the girl can stay safe.

The acting is actually quite good and makes the relationship feel real, even when things get scary. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the ending really picks up and gives you some shocks. If you like stories about dangerous people and unexpected bonds, you will love this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a big reveal about the man's true nature and his violent past. As the tension peaks, the girl realizes her new friend is not who he claimed to be. A final struggle breaks out where the man's mental state completely slips. In the end, the danger is stopped, but the girl is left changed by the experience. It wraps up by showing that some secrets are too dangerous to keep.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and dark stories about unlikely friendships.
